Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.4.0.9999

New features - Add a min_epochs parameter to early stopping, so that training runs for at least that many epochs before it can stop early (#36). - Start the bias of the output layer at the log-odds of the outcome rate in the training data, controlled by initOutputBias in setEstimator() and on by default. Models with rare outcomes no longer spend their first epochs lowering all predictions to the outcome rate, which with few batches per epoch let early stopping end training before the model ranked patients. This removes most of the instability in ResNet learning curves. It applies to models with a single-logit linear head, and not to the learning rate search. - Add a curvature argument to setCustomEmbeddingModel() for Poincare embeddings trained in a ball whose curvature is not -1. HypLL, which OHDSI/context uses, applies softplus to its curvature parameter, so its default of 1, when not trained, is a curvature of about -1.313.

Bug fixes - Avoid a segfault in batched matrix multiplication on Ubuntu 26.04. On Linux, torch is now imported with RTLD_DEEPBIND so that it does not call the system OpenBLAS, which has a crash in cblas_sgemm_batch. This is a temporary workaround until distributions ship the OpenBLAS fix. A startup message explains the risk if torch was already imported before the package loaded (#191). - Normalize custom embedding concept IDs for Polars 2 (#189). - Restore the weights of the best epoch after training. Checkpoints shared storage with the live model, so cross-validation predictions came from the last epoch. - Select the automatic learning rate within each fold on training data only, so that held-out outcomes no longer influence it. - Invalidate the training cache when the data, outcomes, folds, feature mapping, estimator settings, tuning metric, or the contents of finetuning and custom embedding files change, not only the parameter grid. Caches from earlier versions are recomputed. - Use the tuning metric and direction requested through hyperparameterSettings when selecting hyperparameters and trimming the cache. Its search, sampleSize, randomSeed and generator settings are not used, and a warning now says so; the search is set in the model settings. - Give tied positive and negative predictions half credit in the AUC used for early stopping and epoch selection. - Clear gradients between learning rate finder trials. - Handle a loss minimum within the first few learning rate finder steps. It failed with an argmin error, or picked a rate from beyond the minimum. - Train the final model when the data is smaller than one batch, instead of silently returning an untrained model. - Score validation data whose last batch holds a single patient, which failed with a zero-dimensional tensor error. - Report training and validation loss per observation when the last batch is incomplete. - Keep patients without any retained covariates when training and predicting, and raise an error if predictions do not match the cohort. - Pass the beta2 setting of RealMLP to the optimizer. AdamW used its default of 0.999 instead of RealMLP’s 0.95, so RealMLP results change. - Assign custom embeddings to the right covariates. Vectors were shifted to the preceding column, and depended on the order of the embeddings file. A concept with more than one vector in the file is now an error. - Make predictions independent of the padded sequence width for custom embedding models, RealMLP with mean aggregation and convolutional positional encodings. - Compute time token gaps in days from the time reference: its timePart and timeInterval for temporal sequence covariates, or the start day of each time window for covariates with explicit windows. Raise an error if neither is available. - Keep column and covariate IDs apart when loading RealMLP wide coefficients. A row’s covariateId is used when it has one, so coefficients exported from another model, such as a covariateImportance file, load correctly. - Leave frozen RealMLP layers unchanged during data-dependent initialization. - Use the requested sigma in TemporalPE when it is not learnable. It was applied as exp(sigma), so the default of 1 acted as 2.72. - Add the trainable offsets of PoincareEmbeddings in the tangent space at the origin. For the Transformer and RealMLP they were combined with the mapped vectors by Mobius addition, which is defined for points inside the ball, not for tangent vectors. - Check that Poincare embeddings are finite and inside the ball. Vectors outside it passed through without being mapped, and vectors on its boundary became infinite. Compute the log map accurately near the boundary and for small curvatures, and reject trainable ball coordinates, which a Euclidean optimizer can move outside the ball. - Apply the projection of custom embeddings, used when the embeddings file has another dimension than the model, to custom features only. Its bias was added once per patient for ResNet and MLP, and to every padding and regular feature for the Transformer and RealMLP. - Leave the batch given to custom embeddings unchanged. Its custom features were set to zero, so RealMLP lost them in its wide branch and in data-dependent initialization. - Load custom embedding files saved from GPU tensors, and reject Poincare embeddings too close to the boundary of the ball to be mapped in their precision. - Continue the hyperparameter search after a combination runs out of GPU memory, and free that combination’s memory first. Since torch 2.5 the error was not recognized, so the search stopped. The cleanup could not free memory that the error’s traceback still referred to, and instead, when more than 3 GB stayed allocated, emptied the storage of every CUDA tensor, including those still in use.

Runtime and compatibility - Require Python 3.11 or newer. Python 3.10 reached end-of-life in October 2026, and duckdb 2.0.0 requires Python 3.11. - Require PatientLevelPrediction 6.6.0 or newer, which added tuning metrics. - Models trained with custom embeddings, RealMLP mean aggregation, time tokens, convolutional positional encodings or a fixed TemporalPE sigma compute their inputs differently now. Predictions from such saved models change, so retrain them. - Poincare embeddings with vectors outside the ball are now an error, also when predicting with a model saved by an earlier version. - Drop the nvidia-ml-py Python dependency.

Documentation and CI - Add an Ubuntu 26.04 CI job and a regression test for batched matrix multiplication. - Stop pinning Python duckdb on macOS CI, because version 1.5.2 cannot read files written by R duckdb 2.0.0. - Update tlmgr before installing LaTeX packages in the R-devel CI job.

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.4.0

New features - Add hyperparameter tuning support for RealMLP.

Bug fixes - Keep temporal dataset feature_ids, feature_values, and time_ids aligned when multiple features share the same time ID.

Documentation and CI - Refresh RealMLP examples for current grid/random tuning behavior. - Add a dedicated temporal transformer vignette. - Update CI and installation guidance to validate the recommended Python environment with Python 3.14 and torch 2.12.1. - Pin Python duckdb to 1.5.2 on macOS CI to avoid intermittent shutdown segfaults. - Limit push-triggered R CMD checks to develop and main while keeping pull request checks enabled for all branches. - Refresh vignette wording and examples for current runtime guidance.

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.3.0

New features - Add core RealMLP support for tabular deep learning, including paper-style numeric embeddings, schedules, and data-dependent initialization (PR #171) - Add dropout support to TemporalPE and test coverage for positional-encoding dropout behavior (PR #165)

Bug fixes - Replace deprecated pynvml with nvidia-ml-py (PR #167, closes #166) - Improve expand-component handling and add regression tests (PR #164) - Fix estimator seed casting, prediction shaping, and custom-embedding / Poincare model paths for current torch and reticulate behavior (PR #171)

Runtime and compatibility - Relax the torch requirement to torch>=2.7,<3 and validate against torch==2.10.0 in stable CI lanes (PR #171) - Add a Python 3.10 compatibility lane using the latest available torch (PR #171) - Clean torchinductor_runner artifacts during R CMD check (PR #171)

Documentation and CI - Update installation guidance to recommend uv and Python 3.12 (PR #171) - Update GitHub Actions checks to use Python 3.12 by default and fix Windows torch installation handling (PR #171) - Update pkgdown link checking for current lychee CLI behavior (PR #171)

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.2.0

  • [Feature] Add positional encodings that use timeId (PR #154):
    • SinusoidalPE: Absolute sinusoidal positional embeddings using
    • LearnablePE: Learnable absolute positional embeddings
    • TapePE: Time-absolute Positional Encodings (tAPE)
    • RotaryPE: Rotary position embeddings (RoPE)
    • RelativePE: Relative positional embeddings (RPE)
    • EfficientRPE: Efficient relative positional embeddings (eRPE)
    • TemporalPE: Combines an absolute temporal embedding and a semantic one
    • StochasticConvPE: Relative learnable positional embedding (convSPE)
    • HybridRoPEconvPE: Combines RoPE and convSPE
    • TUPE: Transformer with learnable positional encoding (TUPE)
    • ALiBiPE: Attention with linear biases (ALiBi)
  • [Feature] Use py_require from reticulate to manage python dependencies and update min requirements (PR #150)
  • [Internal] Refactor transformer/dataset/embedding classes to use the same code whether temporal or not (PR #147)
  • [Feature] Use train/validation split for model selection instead of cross validation (PR #145)
  • [Feature] Temporal transformer added which supports RoPE and time tokens (PR #147)
  • [Feature] Temporal data processing added (PR #147)
  • [CI] Use uv for python in github actions (PR #136)
  • [Feature] Add an option to use torch compile (PR #133)
  • [Feature] More efficient conversions from polars to torch in dataset processing (PR #133)
  • [CI] Automatically detect broken links in docs using github actions
  • [Feature] Initialize models with embeddings, including Poincare (PR #125 and PR #130)
  • [Feature] Model initialization made more flexible with classes (PR #124)

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.1.0

  • Added basic transfer learning functionality. See vignette(“TransferLearning”)
  • Add a gpu memory cleaner to clean cached memory after out of memory error
  • The python module torch is now accessed through an exported function instead of loading the module at package load
  • Added gradient accumulation. Studies running at different sites using different hardware can now use same effective batch size by accumulating gradients.
  • Refactored out the cross validation from the hyperparameter tuning
  • Remove predictions from non-optimal hyperparameter combinations to save space
  • Only use html vignettes
  • Rename MLP to MultiLayerPerceptron

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.0.3

  • Hotfix: Fix count for polars v0.20.x

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.0.2

  • Ensure output from predict_proba is numeric instead of 1d array
  • Refactoring: Move cross-validation to a separate function
  • Refactoring: Move paramsToTune to a separate function
  • linting: Enforcing HADES style
  • Calculate AUC ourselves with torch, get rid of scikit-learn dependency
  • added Andromeda to dev dependencies
